author.name: Model Monica
author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: The current workflow for tracking which model version is live in each store is done by hand and breaks down under load. I need a fully automated model registry so that every deployment is traceable and reproducible without human intervention. When we retrain weekly, the risk of serving an untested variant is too high. I want the system to automatically log every change and link it to the specific evaluation metrics. The more automated this process is, the better, because manual steps introduce errors that erode trust in the forecast. I am asking for complete automation of the registry entry and validation pipeline to ensure that the model running in production is always the exact one that passed our tests.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that 'the more automated this process is, the better' and requests complete automation, indicating that exceeding the baseline level of automation would make them happier rather than being a hard refusal line.
